cohort: 369 pregnant women with IBD (CD or UC)
finding: History of perianal disease and prior Cesarean delivery were the strongest predictors of Cesarean delivery in women with CD, while history of colectomy was a predictor in women with UC, and CD and UC both increased postpartum length of stay after Cesarean delivery compared to vaginal delivery.
mod_finding: The Cesarean delivery rate among women with CD was 52% and for women with UC it was 48%, with history of perianal disease and prior Cesarean delivery being the strongest predictors in women with CD, and history of colectomy a predictor in women with UC.
